translation_notes: all 34 term constructions become islands, in ordinary Python operand positions: URIRef("urn:current1") -> <urn:current1>, RDF.type -> rdf:type, NAMED_GRAPH_NAMESPACE["DIFF_ADD"] -> namedgraph:DIFF_ADD, ex.a/ex.T1 -> ex:a/ex:T1 inside tuple, list, assert and keyword-argument contexts

the function-local 'ex = Namespace("http://example.org/")' is absorbed by a function-body '@prefix ex: <http://example.org/> .' at the same line -- the block scope of @prefix matches the scope of the variable it replaces exactly

the mechanical draft used the Python variable names as prefixes ('named-graph-namespace:'); a hyphen is legal in a Turtle prefix but unusable in expression position, so it was renamed to 'namedgraph:'. Prefix naming has to be chosen by a human here.

the data flow is unchanged: the triples stay Python tuples in a list ([(ex:a, rdf:type, ex:T1)]), not a g{...} graph, because _add_triples takes an iterable of triples and the original builds no graph
imports: RDF, Namespace and URIRef dropped (absorbed by the declarations), NAMED_GRAPH_NAMESPACE dropped (absorbed by @prefix namedgraph:); Literal kept although the extracted region never uses it

context shim: cognite.neat is not installed; cognite_neat_shim.py provides NAMED_GRAPH_NAMESPACE verbatim and a NeatInstanceStore reduced to __init__/from_oxi_local_store/graph/named_graphs/_add_triples/diff with the upstream bodies (CLEAR SILENT GRAPH updates + the FILTER NOT EXISTS diff query). from_oxi_local_store falls back to an in-memory rdflib Dataset because oxrdflib is absent; the named-graph diff behaviour under test is store-independent. Identical for both sides.
the eight assertions of the test pass on both sides, so equivalence here also means the rewritten terms are the ones the store actually stores and retrieves
